card.name: Sentence ends in topical use directions
card.fires_on: Sentence-ending periods or bullets in dosage directions for skin or spray products, right before the next step such as 'Apply a thin layer'. Also the word 'apply' or 'dilute' in these steps.

modes.label: Period after prep step
modes.description: The period ending a skin-prep or spray instruction, just before the next instruction.
modes.example: Rinse and pat the skin dry<<.>> Apply a thin film of BLEMISH

modes.label: Apply or dilute verb
modes.description: The verb that starts the product-use step in a dosage section.
modes.example: After the skin is dry,<< apply>> a thin uniform layer of WINLEVI

modes.label: Bullet before apply
modes.description: A bullet mark that separates prep steps from the apply step.
modes.example: dry thoroughly<< •>> Apply a thin layer of product over affected

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward naming the product (words like 'product' and 'products') in the next step.
card.plain: It marks the end of a preparation step in directions, where the text is about to say to use the product.
